len.name: Len
len.description: What is a VTuber doing in this game?

EnabledMikuAI.title: Enable Act I Elite: MIKU
EnabledMikuAI.description: Whether to add this enemy to the pool or not.

EnabledSounds.title: Enable Intrusive SFX
EnabledSounds.description: Various cards trigger SFX-based music which may be annoying for some.

BananaTreat.name: Banana Treat
BananaTreat.description: At start of turn, <c=action>eat</c> <=boldPink>{0}</c> <c=status>bananas</c> without reducing the stash.

MusicNote.name: Music Note
MusicNote.description: At start of turn, add a special card to hand. Gain 1 <c=status>note</c> on turn end if <c=hurt>hull</c> at <c=redd>half</c> or less. Reset at max stacks. <c=status>Persists across battles</c>.

EatBanana.name: Eat Banana
EatBanana.description: Len <c=action>eats</c> a <c=status>banana</c>, making the enemy so hungry they lose <c=hurt>{{Damage}}</c> <c=hurt>hull</c>.  Requires bananas in most cases.

ThrowBanana.name: Throw Banana
ThrowBanana.description: Len <c=action>throws</c> a <c=status>banana</c> so fast it deals <c=boldPink>{{Damage}}</c> damage to the enemy. Requires bananas in most cases.

BananaSnack.name: BANANA SNACK
BananaSnack.description: At start of combat, lose 1 <c=status>BANANA</c> to gain 1 <c=status>BANANA TREAT</c>.

Brioche.name: BRIOCHE
Brioche.description:
<c=405a7f>Her favorite.</c>
On pickup, <c=status>BANANA</c> damage is increased by 1.

GlassBottle.name: GLASS BOTTLE
GlassBottle.description:
<c=405a7f>Who's wish was inside it?</c>
At start of combat, gain 3 <c=status>BANANAS</c>.

Guillotine.name: GUILLOTINE
Guillotine.description:
<c=405a7f>I'll continue watching over you.</c>
On pickup, <c=action>thrown</c> <c=status>BANANAS</c>' damage becomes <c=action>piercing</c>.

MaidDress.name: MAID DRESS
MaidDress.description: <c=status>BANANAS</c> now give you 2 <c=status>SHIELD</c> before <c=action>eating</c> or <c=action>throwing</c> them.

TwinPower.name: TWIN POWER
TwinPower.description: Gain 1 extra <c=energy>ENERGY</c> every turn. <c=downside>On even turns, enemy ship gains 2</c> <c=status>overdrive</c>.

ToluthinAntenna.name: Toluthin Antenna
ToluthinAntenna.description: Gain 1 <c=status>note</c>. Add 1 of {{Amount}} <c=cardtrait>discount, temp</c> cards to your hand.

LenExe.name: Len.EXE
LenExe.description: Add 1 of {{Amount}} <c=cardtrait>discount, temp</c> <c=ffe569>Len</c> cards to your hand.

Encore.name: Encore 39
Encore.descriptionMiku: <c=hurt>Turn End: Flood</c> with <c=7ed2d6>Fan Letters</c>, <c=7ed2d6>Set Trends</c> & <c=7ed2d6>World Is Mine</c>.
